title: Create: Extended Gantries
description: More Gantries for your extended create gantry needs
body:
# Create: Extended Gantries

This is a relatively small addon for the create mod that extends what is possible with gantries

## Features:
- Gantry split
  a simple modified gantry shaft that allows spliting a gantry shaft into multiple sections that can be moved independently while still being continuoysly traversable.
